notes.null: 20 fixed label permutations x 3 training seeds per family; T_null = 95th percentile of the per-permutation three-seed means; verdict = exact count, p = (#{means >= arm} + 1) / 21, clears = p <= .05; z uses sqrt(SD_perm^2 + SD_train^2 / 3); T95_single = 95th percentile of the 60 single runs (not the threshold)
notes.enrichment: Delta SR = base_fail x (enrichment - 1) by construction; the reconciliation of the two scorings is the cell-for-cell Y == (CLS < .5) check in target()
